label: Internal reception excludes incoming actual esse supply at identity (inference)
rule: An incoming actual cause implies a receiver that would be in receptive potency to itself
meaning: For a bearer whose represented esse is its essence, the cause-to-reception bridge would make its esse received in some principle. Identity-scoped reception fixes that principle as the bearer's essence, here identical to its esse. The receiver-potency law then contradicts the irreflexivity of receptive potency. The cause-to-reception bridge retains its act-of-being individuation scope. The derivation uses the same self-potency inference as contingentDistinctEsseFromReception with a causal antecedent in place of contingency.
